about: How your AI tool decides whether a piece of work belongs on your résumé. Each item in your inbox is scored 0, 1, or 2 on every criterion. Edit the target and the criteria to match the work you want next.
target: Roles where hiring teams want proof of results, good judgment, and reliability. Change this to the work you want next, in your own words.

criteria.name: Outcome
criteria.ask: Did something ship, get used, or change a result? Is there a fact you could point to (users, issues found and fixed, time saved, launch)?

criteria.name: Scope and ownership
criteria.ask: How much did the person own: an idea to launch, a full system, a team or client relationship?

criteria.name: Rigor and quality
criteria.ask: Checking work, testing, reviews, accessibility, measured improvement. Evidence of care, not just speed.

criteria.name: Accountability
criteria.ask: Owning results, handling data or money carefully, fixing mistakes.

criteria.name: Judgment
criteria.ask: A real decision or tradeoff, explained: what was chosen over what, and why.

criteria.name: Current and in demand
criteria.ask: Does it show skills or tools hiring teams are asking for now?

criteria.name: Adds something new
criteria.ask: Does the résumé already say this? Would it replace or strengthen an existing line?

bar.rule: Propose only when the total is at least propose_at and the item adds something new. Otherwise skip and say honestly why, and what would make it résumé-worthy.
